narrative.details:
I'm thinking those items you acquired for Lotwil are going to be the least of our worries, adventurer. On the other hand, you've proven more than adept at the sciences Lotwil holds sacred, so how about helping me out?

I need an invisibility potion and a healing potion; both might come in handy real soon if he pulls this off.

In return, I'll give you this recipe for a potion I've been developing while learning from Lotwil. It's based on some of the research he's been doing here in the Badlands.
narrative.objectives: Bring a Healing Potion and a Lesser Invisibility Potion to Lucien Tosselwrench in the Badlands.
narrative.offerRewardText:
YES!

I mean, thank you, adventurer. These will be helpful while traveling through the Badlands.
narrative.requestItemsText: He's getting closer to finishing. How are things going on your end?
